description: Three fail-open advisory hooks: (1) UserPromptSubmit nudge deterministically steers Claude toward the nexus.memory_create / nexus.context_retrieve MCP tools on cross-session memory write/read intent (lifetime-axis rules shared with skills/nexus-memory/SKILL.md via hooks/rules.json); (2) SessionStart injection warm-starts a fresh session with the project's recent settled summaries (cross-container, provenance-annotated) via context/retrieve; (3) SessionEnd capture distills the session transcript into bounded activities and POSTs them to /activities/stream (P1 write side; backend worker extracts episodic memory keyed user_id=project). All are advisory only — never block the prompt, session startup, or teardown; fail-open exit 0.
